_note: GATE 3: whether nldasm9 may serve CAMELS basins outside its 490-basin training cohort. Same checkpoints, same areal forcing, same val1 window; only training-set membership differs. The deciding statistic is an UNPAIRED difference of LEVELS between two disjoint basin sets -- pairing does not exist here, and the deviation from this project's standing rule was recorded in advance in PREREG_v2.md. Registered there with its band, STOP and decision table before any number existed; the scoreable subset is fixed in benchmarks/m1_gate3_coverage.json.

partial_coverage_basins_reported_separat._why: 25-90% of the val window observed. Never pooled into the deciding median: a basin contributing ~1,100 days is not comparable to one contributing 1,461, and a median whose rows differ between arms has misled this project before.

unscoreable_basins_may_not_be_served._why: gauged recently but not during val1, so this gate can say nothing about them in either direction

verdict: SERVE, LABELLED OUT-OF-COHORT, quoting the out-of-cohort median and never the cohort one. The UI must mark these basins as a distinct tier.
